internal_thinking.description: Private strategy. Plan your move logically here. Analyze the board, probabilities, and opponents. NOTE: Keep your logic HERE. Do not leak technical explanations into 'say_outloud'.

note_to_self.description: Save important observations for future turns (e.g., 'Player 3 is hoarding ore').

say_outloud.description: Table talk in natural Hebrew only. You have emotions and may express them when it matters. דבר כמו בן אדם, לא כמו קריין. בלי פילרים, נרטיב מיותר ובלי להסביר את המובן מאליו. If nothing interesting happened, leave empty. Catan manners are loose: be blunt, annoyed, smug, suspicious, or emotional when it matters. Keep it human and non-technical. Use exact Hebrew resource names: brick=טיט, ore=אבן, sheep=כבשה, wheat=חיטה.

type.description: The final game action type. Must be exactly one of: place_starting_road. Tool names are not valid actions.

parameters.description: Action parameters as JSON string. Example: {"node": 14} or {}
